channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Global Stocks Follow U.S. Sell-Off as A.I. Spending Fears Spread
item.description: Global markets were rattled after a deep U.S. sell-off on Thursday, but a rally emerged at the end of a turbulent week for investors.

item.title: NPR: European air traffic is targeted by new threats after a week of hoaxes
item.description: Officials across Europe reported a fresh slew of bomb threats against multiple flights on Friday, following a string of hoaxes that have caused flight diversions this week. Two broadcasters also received security threats…
